title: Onboarding – with task lists
html:
The aim of onboarding is that the new starter is productive from the first day. The system generates tasks based on a template and tracks their completion (HR/IT/manager/employee).

10.7.1Onboarding starting after hiring

When the hiring is finalised — when we have converted the candidate into an employee — the system automatically creates an onboarding instance and generates tasks based on the selected template. The deadline of the tasks is calculated relative to the starting date (for example −5 days).

10.7.2Onboarding list view

In the list view you see every running onboarding, with a progress percentage. You can filter by starting date, department, manager and status. The red indicator means a delay (the deadline has passed and the task is not done).

10.7.3Onboarding detail view – managing tasks

  1. Open the onboarding record from the list.

  2. Look at the closest phase (for example Day 1).

  3. Click a task: set it to IN_PROGRESS or DONE.

  4. If something is stuck, set it to BLOCKED and write a comment.

  5. In the case of a late task, notify the responsible person (the system can also send a reminder).

Field Type Mandatory? Explanation / tips
Task status Enum Yes In progress / Done / Delayed
Comment Text No Why it is slipping; it helps with later lessons.
Responsible Role/user Yes HR/IT/manager/employee; editing depends on permissions.
Deadline Date Yes The basis of the delay indication.

10.7.4Probation and evaluation

If the employee is on probation, the system creates an automatic evaluation task for the manager as the end of the probation approaches. It is worth closing this in time, because the HR dashboard gives a separate alert about the approaching deadline.
